summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the rebuilt Council login screen (/admin). Backend API fully functional with correct lockout mechanism. Frontend UI elements all present with proper data-testids. Responsive design works across all devices (desktop, tablet, mobile). Found ONE CRITICAL BUG: language switching navigates away from /admin instead of staying on the page.

action_item_for_main_agent: FIX CRITICAL BUG: Language switching on /admin login page navigates away to homepage. The Nav component's language buttons (FR/EN) should switch language WITHOUT navigation when on /admin. Expected behavior per requirements: 'switching does not navigate away from /admin'. Current behavior: clicking EN navigates to /. This breaks the requirement that users should be able to see English labels ('THE COUNCIL'S CHEST', 'COURIER/SECRET/OPENING') without leaving the login page.
